Class Message<T>

Represents a message envelope that wraps a strongly-typed payload and common messaging metadata.

public class Message<T> where T : class

Examples

var msg = new Message<Order>(order)
{
    Subject = "order.created",
    CorrelationId = correlationId,
    TimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30),
    Properties = { ["priority"] = "high" }
};

Remarks

This class is intended as a lightweight envelope used by message producers and consumers within the NuvTools.Notification.Messaging library. It carries the payload in Body and common metadata such as MessageId, CorrelationId, Subject, TimeToLive, and a flexible Properties map for custom headers.

The default constructor generates a new MessageId. The class itself does not impose any serialization or transport requirements — those are handled by the concrete sender/consumer implementations.
